title: Ron ve Rubi Müzedeki Tuzak
author: Fatih Cem Gülbent
description: Puzzle Land Bulbulya is in danger once again. This time, the danger lies within the Bulbulya Museum. The country's smartest parrot, Rubi, and puzzle expert Ron are counting on your help to find the clues.
english_title: Ron and Rubi The Trap in the Museum
